About

Hi, I'm Cindy Mao.

In July 2024, I came to Singapore with three suitcases and a dream: to study data science at the National University of Singapore and build a life around curiosity. I graduated with my MSc in Data Science in June 2026, and today I work as a Business Analyst at HP Singapore.

My focus is Agentic AI Solution Architecture & Product Design — designing agentic AI solutions, LLM applications and products that save teams hours and make decisions clearer.

Projects

Selected projects

Twelve things I've built and loved — from real-time market intelligence and geospatial research to a trilingual tool that's now live for anyone to try.

Games & Fun

Just Spin It!

A cute spin-wheel game that helps you decide where to travel next — spin by continent, then country, then city, choosing from 40 countries and 162 cities — and also settles what to eat and what to do, with 30 ideas for each. It is made for anyone who gets stuck choosing: one quick spin turns an “I don't know, you pick!” moment into a plan, in English, Traditional Chinese and Japanese.

Live Demo ↗ View on GitHub ↗
AI & Tools

AI ROI Calculator for SMEs

Find where AI pays off for a small or medium business — estimate ROI by process, rank use cases, and plan a 90-day implementation. Adjusts for AI the business already uses, such as Microsoft 365 Copilot or Google Gemini, so savings are never double-counted. Download the report as a PDF.

Live Demo ↗ View on GitHub ↗
AI & Tools

Engineering Report Translator

A trilingual AI tool that turns engineers' technical notes into a short, manager-ready report, for teams who need to share progress clearly across languages. It rewrites detailed technical updates into concise, business-friendly summaries in English, Traditional Chinese and Japanese, keeping the key points without the jargon. Built as a single-page tool and shipped live for anyone to try.

Live Demo ↗ View on GitHub ↗

AI Resume Health Check

Check your resume against a job description — get a match score, spot the skills you're missing, fix what matters most first, and rewrite bullets with clearer impact. Runs 100% in your browser, no upload needed.

AI & Tools

InsightMarket

A real-time market intelligence platform that helps investors and business users follow market movements without piecing together scattered sources. It brings live trends, charts and AI-generated insights together in one clear dashboard, so users can spot shifts, compare signals and make more informed decisions. Built as a web app with Gemini-powered analysis at its core.

Data Science

Stock Trends and Returns

A data science project that explores how global stock markets performed across 2023–2024, designed for readers who want a clear view of market direction. It cleans and compares price and return data across markets, then visualises trends over time to show which markets rose, fell or recovered. Built with Python-based analysis and data visualisation.

View on GitHub ↗
Sustainability

Sumatra Landcover Analysis (2012–2022)

A geospatial research project examining how Sumatra's land cover changed between 2012 and 2022, for readers interested in environment and sustainability. It maps forest loss, agricultural expansion and fire hotspots over time, helping explain where change is concentrated and what may be driving it. Built with QGIS, Python and R for spatial analysis and mapping.

View on GitHub ↗
AI & Tools

QR Code Generator

A simple browser tool for anyone who needs a QR code for a link, event or everyday sharing. Users can enter their content, customise the code and download it instantly, with everything generated locally in the browser for speed and privacy. Built as a lightweight single-page web tool with no sign-up needed.

Sustainability

ESG Scoring System

A scoring system that helps assess how companies perform on environmental, social and governance factors, for readers who need a structured view of sustainability performance. It combines multiple ESG metrics into a clear scoring approach, making it easier to compare companies and see strengths and gaps at a glance. Built as a data-driven analysis project using multi-metric evaluation methods.

Data Science

House Price Prediction

A machine learning project that predicts house prices, built for exploring how property features shape real estate value. It trains and compares regression models on housing data, examining which factors influence price most, so results stay clear and interpretable. Built with Python and regression techniques.

View on GitHub ↗
Data Science

Discount Analysis on Conversion Rate

An exploratory data analysis project that examines how discounts affect whether shoppers actually buy, for marketing and business readers. It compares conversion rates across product categories and discount levels, helping reveal where promotions encourage purchases and where they may not. Built with Python-based analysis and visualisation to turn sales data into practical insights.

Blog

Notes from the journey

A few notes in my own words — little pieces of the journey so far.

Published on April 27, 2025

Studying and Living in Singapore

Studying in Singapore is an inspiring journey, surrounded by people from all over the world. Through daily interactions, I am meeting friends from different countries and learning about their cultures, values, and traditions. Singapore's diverse environment continues to expand my worldview and strengthen my appreciation for global connections.

Published on April 26, 2025

Why I Love Data Science

I've always been curious about how things work and why people make certain choices. Data science lets me explore those questions, solve problems, and share what I find with others. I love that it's not just about numbers — it's about understanding people, ideas, and the stories behind the data.

Interests

Developing Products

Personality

How I work best

From my personality profile: a flexible, self-driven creator — logic- and data-driven, creative, and happiest working on varied projects toward clear goals.

Self-driven & goal-setting

I set my own goals, spot opportunities, and come up with new ideas — self-driven and organised, I turn them into finished results.

Small teams & cross-functional collaboration

I work well in small, focused teams of two to three people where everyone owns their piece — and I collaborate just as well across departments and functions, bringing different teams together toward a shared goal.

Varied projects

I thrive on varied projects and enjoy tackling different kinds of problems at once. Variety keeps me sharp, adaptable, and always learning.

Flexible & adaptable

Cafés, changing places, frequent travel — I'm comfortable with change and new environments, and they keep my ideas fresh.

Meaning over money

Having enough money is enough for me. What really motivates me is recognition — and finishing entrepreneurial, interesting projects.

Fail fast, try again

When something doesn't work, I don't dwell on it — I try a new method immediately.

In short: Flexible & adaptable Logic & data-driven Creative Self-driven Comfortable with change Collaborative across teams
